note: WP-00 proposed ledger. Each entry records an intentional ltmrs deviation from pinned Lemma 0.21.0 behavior. A consumer needing exact upstream behavior uses a reference profile or upstream; these are not silent.

deviations.upstream_behavior: TF-IDF lexical ranking only; scores are raw TF-IDF/RRF values.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Dense Candle embeddings + hybrid lexical/dense RRF + graph-aware context + calibrated scoring.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Different result ordering and score interpretation; no byte-identical equivalence.
deviations.release_wording: Complete supported Lemma API/workflow surface with documented retrieval enhancements.

deviations.upstream_behavior: confirm=true stores a fragment verbatim despite secret detection.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Policy-dependent: approved legacy policy preserves the override; a stricter policy rejects it explicitly.
deviations.reason: Security hardening must be named, never silent redaction (Part I 12.1).
deviations.user_visible_impact: Under a strict policy, confirm=true may be rejected with a policy error.
deviations.release_wording: Secret detection is best-effort; verbatim override is policy-gated and documented.

deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Sessions bound to authenticated frontend channels; no daemon-global current session.
deviations.reason: RV-05: multi-agent correctness requires per-channel session isolation.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Concurrent independent frontends stay isolated; legacy single-client behavior preserved per channel.
deviations.release_wording: Session isolation across concurrent frontends; per-channel legacy semantics retained.

deviations.upstream_behavior: source is a free-form string stored verbatim; the detail icon is 'ai' -> robot, anything else -> person.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: source is a strict enum (user|ai); unknown values are coerced to 'ai' at add time.
deviations.reason: Strict domain typing (AGENTS.md); the real upstream DB contains non-canonical source values (e.g. 'user-corrected formal review') that the enum cannot express.
deviations.user_visible_impact: A memory added with a non-canonical source renders the robot icon and is counted under 'ai' in stats, where upstream would show the person icon and the original string.
deviations.release_wording: Source is normalized to the canonical user/ai vocabulary; non-canonical upstream source strings are not preserved verbatim.

deviations.upstream_behavior: Ranks context injection and empty-query recall with injectionScore (confidence*0.7 + recency*0.3); computes a composite quality_score on every fragment touch.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Uses its own calibrated native scorer (design 10.3) for ranking; quality_score is an optional passthrough field, never computed natively.
deviations.reason: Intentional retrieval enhancement (Part I 10.3); upstream formulas retained as reference oracles (reference::injection_score, reference::calculate_quality_score) for differential testing only.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Different recall/injection ordering and no live quality_score values; neither formula is exposed on the wire.
deviations.test: T-RANK-01, T-RANK-02; differential tests calculate_quality_score_matches_upstream, injection_score_matches_upstream
deviations.release_wording: Enhanced native ranking; upstream quality/injection formulas preserved as frozen reference oracles, not native behavior.

deviations.upstream_behavior: Project attribution auto-detected from client working directory.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Project is explicit per call; sessions are project-less (the daemon does not observe client cwd).
deviations.reason: Daemon-side cwd observation is unavailable and spoofable; explicit attribution is auditable.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Calls without an explicit project are unattributed; no silent cwd-derived projects.
deviations.release_wording: Project scope is explicit; no cwd-derived attribution.

deviations.upstream_behavior: Fuzzy duplicate refusal on near-identical adds (plus auto-link on add).
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Duplicate detection via 0.80 word-overlap threshold; auto-link behavior differs (see workflow notes).
deviations.reason: Deterministic, testable duplicate policy independent of upstream heuristics.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Near-duplicate adds may be refused or linked differently than upstream.
deviations.release_wording: Duplicate handling follows documented ltmrs thresholds, not upstream heuristics.

deviations.upstream_behavior: Ships 4 seed fragments; appends coaching blocks to session output; auto-detects technologies; suggests distill on session end; read ordering differs.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: No seed fragments; no coaching blocks; no technology auto-detection; no distill suggestion; canonical read ordering.
deviations.reason: Instructional content and catalog seeding are host/model concerns, not canonical store behavior.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Fresh stores start empty; session output contains no coaching text.
deviations.release_wording: No seeded content or coaching output; workflow activation is host-driven.

deviations.upstream_behavior: Per-host skill paths with verified host behavior.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Mechanism-based host recipes; entries are documented recipes, not verified per-host behavior.
deviations.reason: Host matrix verification requires tested host versions not yet exercised.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Install recipes may need adaptation per host version.
deviations.release_wording: Host support is recipe-based; per-host verification pending.

deviations.ltmrs_behavior: Legacy .lemma-backup payloads refused explicitly (RQ-21: no C++ database engine); native .ltmrs-backup is the supported interchange path.
deviations.reason: Opening SQLite requires a C database engine excluded by the audited native-code policy.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Legacy backups cannot be imported; they are refused with a reason, never converted silently.
deviations.release_wording: Legacy backup import unsupported; native backup/restore only.

deviations.upstream_behavior: hybrid flag Default: false (pure TF-IDF); absent means lexical-only.
deviations.ltmrs_behavior: hybrid is Option<bool>: absent means hybrid when a dense backend is attached (current default); Some(false) forces lexical-only (upstream parity on demand); Some(true) is hybrid.
deviations.reason: Dense backend is the calibrated default path; explicit opt-out preserves parity (Part I 11.2).
deviations.user_visible_impact: Absent hybrid returns dense-enriched results where upstream returns TF-IDF-only; pass hybrid:false for upstream-identical behavior.
deviations.test: hybrid absent/explicit unit tests in frontend::mcp (I8)
deviations.release_wording: semantic_search runs hybrid retrieval by default; hybrid:false restores pure lexical parity.

deviations.ltmrs_behavior: explain:true emits an ltmrs-native explanation object (engine readiness / dense-fallback mode, scope filter, partial flags) with no upstream counterpart.
deviations.reason: Readiness/partial transparency required by design 10.x; additive field, no wire regression.
deviations.user_visible_impact: Extra explanation object only when explain:true is passed; default responses unchanged.
deviations.test: explain readiness unit tests in frontend::mcp (I8)
deviations.release_wording: semantic_search accepts explain:true for a native readiness/partial explanation.
